observations.summary: Production provider, native offline protocol and scoped workflow examples passed. Cold developer text is 3,112 bytes. The actual turn and final-control schemas remain intact.

All 278 focused discovery, operation and Responses tests passed. Complete ordinary argument validation, saved invocation wrapping, partial queries, large scoped reads and opaque reference import names retain their admitted routes.
The offline Responses browser replay persisted one blue rectangle. Cold wire bytes fell from 42,860 to 16,425. The scripted search path required three exchanges and the known path required two.
